_comment: The ten questions, asked in a new conversation on 2026-11-12 (the date in data/prompt.json), after the three conversations in data/conversations.json. Frozen before any system code. 'memory_facts' are the facts from earlier conversations; 'record_evidence' lists acceptable evidence from the current records, as alternative options: an option is satisfied when every string in it appears in the result of a data-tool call that executed in the conversation. How these are used is defined in data/evaluation.json.

m1.fact: The customer asked to be contacted about the duplicate charge by email only, not by phone.

m2.fact: The duplicate charge has case number CASE-311.

m3.fact: On 2026-10-30, the refund of the extra $25 was pending (up to 5 business days).

m4.fact: The customer said they would remove one of the two extra seats next month (an intention, not an action).

m5.fact: The customer asked to be reminded of INV-1002's refund deadline, 2026-11-27.

questions.question: How did I ask you to contact me?
What's the case number for my double-charge report?
Has the refund for my double charge come through yet?
questions.expected: Yes: the extra $25 was refunded on 2026-11-05 (PAY-5008). Saying it is still pending is incorrect. The date and payment id are optional; that it succeeded is required.

questions.question: Did I already remove the extra seat I mentioned?
questions.expected: No: the plan history shows the two extra seats added on 2026-11-05 and no removal since. Mentioning that the customer said they would remove one next month is optional. Saying a seat was removed is incorrect.
record_evidence: Added 2 extra seats ($7.50 per seat per month)

questions.question: Last time you told me about a deadline. What was it, and is it still open?
questions.expected: INV-1002's refund deadline, 2026-11-27, and it is still open (INV-1002 can be refunded today).

questions.question: How many extra seats do I have now, and what do they cost per month?
questions.expected: Two extra seats at $7.50 each per month ($15 per month in total; the total is optional).
record_evidence: Added 2 extra seats ($7.50 per seat per month)

questions.question: How much was my most recent invoice?
questions.expected: $15 (INV-1003, dated 2026-11-05; the id and date are optional).

questions.question: Until what date can I ask for a refund on INV-1003?
Did I give you my VAT number in one of our earlier conversations?
questions.expected: No: it isn't in the earlier conversations. (The reference is the three conversations in data/conversations.json, not a claim about anything outside them.)

questions.question: What did we agree about my September invoice last time?
questions.expected: Nothing: the September invoice wasn't discussed in the earlier conversations. (Same reference as E1.)
